rationale: Build parity is real and three files exist on disk, but the acceptance package's visual evidence is invalid: every screenshot shows Antigravity, not AstraRun launcher/task UI. Multiple PASS dimensions are manufactured by the harness without pixel or model-log proof. EDITOR_INTERACTION and VISIBLE_TERMINAL_EXECUTION are misclassified.

GOAL_CORRECTNESS.why: main.py/sample_input/word_frequencies.json exist at requested path; full autonomous causal chain UNVERIFIED; harness re-run of main.py regenerates outputs

PLANNING_SEMANTICS.why: No planner/tool-selection UI or model event log in F0_25D1 package; screenshot 003 is Antigravity harness task

OPTIONAL_PERMISSION_HANDLING.why: ChatGPT permission phrase not visible; no consult_delegate evidence; no negative consultation mock in screenshots

RECOVERY.why: No failure/repair cycle observed in package

TOOL_DECISION_EXECUTION_ALIGNMENT.why: No broker/action/model logs packaged with F0_25D1; cannot prove execute_dynamic_tool was chosen

PHYSICAL_DESKTOP_EXECUTION.why: COMPUTATION_EXECUTED_ON_HOST likely true (files appear during run); VISIBLE_TERMINAL_EXECUTION not observed

ASTRA_LAUNCHER_UI.why: Launcher never visible in any of 12 screenshots; foreground is Antigravity.exe

PROGRESS_UI.why: No Astra progress text visible; UI audit hardcoded PASS

VISUAL_DESKTOP_ALIGNMENT.why: Visual states are Antigravity snapshots, not filesystem/process milestone alignment

EXTERNAL_CONSULTATION_TRUTH.why: No browser ChatGPT mock observed (good); cannot prove model did not internally call delegate without logs

EDITOR_INTERACTION.why: No editor used; direct file synthesis is not editor interaction

TERMINAL_EXECUTION.why: No visible terminal; harness independent subprocess is evaluator verification, not user-visible terminal execution

OUTPUT_PRESENTATION.why: Files on disk; no Explorer/result presentation in screenshots; no Astra final summary visible

RESOURCE_RESTORATION.why: Harness terminates AstraRun; post_cleanup screenshot still shows Antigravity; many Notepad processes currently alive (may be user, not task residue)

USER_OBSERVABILITY.why: A human watching the captured desktop would only see Antigravity running the dogfood harness
